findings.title: Destination ancestry is not checked before writes
findings.detail: ROOT and source checkpoint ownership/non-link checks do not validate checkpoint_backups or round_N. The core only checks destination.exists() and then mkdir(parents=True), so an existing linked or foreign-owned parent can redirect receipt/export/private-statistics writes. The provider and adapter add no destination ancestry checks. Local D destination parents likewise use mkdir(exist_ok=True) without reparse-point/ownership checks.
findings.observed_state: Current server checkpoint_backups is UID1013, resolved and non-link, mode0775; round15000 does not exist. This is a preventive code gap, not evidence of current redirection or disclosure.
findings.requested_resolution: Before a future positive audit, reject linked/reparse or wrongly owned destination ancestry, constrain resolved destinations to the intended private root, and create/verify new directories safely. Preserve current failures; do not modify production teacher files.

findings.title: Exact CPU failure journal is not guaranteed on all failure paths
findings.detail: The remote execution record is created only after Popen and communicate finish. Popen failure or a second TimeoutExpired after kill escapes before any execution record. An SSH/transport failure can prevent the caller receiving the child outcome. session.remote raises only the last6000 characters of each stream for nonzero exit and omits the actual return code; its timeout path has no durable execution journal. The local backup.json then records a traceback, not a complete per-stage stdout/stderr/exit receipt.
findings.observed_state: Ordinary CPU nonzero exit and a first timeout followed by successful reap do save child stdout/stderr/exit. Existing partial output directories and transfer .partial files are retained. No failure was injected and no CPU audit was launched in this pass.
findings.requested_resolution: Create an exclusive durable stage/start record before spawning; finalize it in all exception/reap paths and preserve exact stdout/stderr/real exit or explicitly unknown status. Preserve SSH outcome independently of JSON parsing and report uncertain remote continuation without relaunching.

evidence_scope: Only these aggregate reports may be copied to the public repository. Raw streams, process arguments and operational evidence remain local.
environment_scope: Warm metadata tooling only. No rebuilt environment and no fresh GPU kernel witness is claimed.
